doc.title: quest
doc.body: Sound effect only: A quest is accepted or finished: a small warm three-note chime, distinct from the level-up flourish. No speech, words, music, or other sounds.

doc.title: quest sound
doc.body: Generate one isolated game sound effect. Follow the description. No speech, words, or music.

doc.title: spoil-rare
